sources: New York DOR remote seller guidance

register_sales_tax.title: Register for New York Sales Tax
register_sales_tax.summary: If you have physical nexus (FBA inventory) or economic nexus ($500,000 AND 100 transactions (includes marketplace sales)) in New York, registration is required.

steps.title: Register with New York DOR
steps.detail: Apply as a remote seller. Threshold: $500,000 AND 100 transactions (includes marketplace sales). State has marketplace-facilitator FBA carve-out — FBA inventory alone may not create nexus.
steps.verification_check: Receive a New York sales tax permit/license number.

steps.title: Note filing frequency and due dates
steps.detail: Typical: quarterly filing. Returns typically due the 20th of the month following the period. Verify assigned frequency after registration.

steps.title: Configure Shopify and update dashboard
steps.detail: Enable NY tax collection in Shopify for direct orders. Amazon handles marketplace orders. Mark NY as registered in the dashboard.

marketplace_facilitator_notes.title: Amazon Marketplace — New York
marketplace_facilitator_notes.summary: Amazon collects and remits NY sales tax on marketplace orders. This does not eliminate registration or filing obligations.

steps.title: Amazon handles sales tax on Amazon orders
steps.detail: You do not owe additional sales tax on Amazon-facilitated orders.

steps.title: Register and file if nexus exists
steps.detail: If you have physical or economic nexus, registration may be required. Returns show Amazon-collected amounts as marketplace deductions.

steps.title: Collect on Shopify/direct
steps.detail: You are responsible for collecting and remitting on direct (Shopify) orders shipped to NY.
